15: """Functions for analyzing an OpenStack cloud before an upgrade."""
16: from __future__ import annotations
17: 
18: import logging
19: from collections.abc import Iterable
20: from dataclasses import dataclass
21: from itertools import chain
22: from typing import Optional
23: 
24: from cou.apps.app import AppFactory, OpenStackApplication
25: from cou.utils import juju_utils
26: from cou.utils.openstack import DATA_PLANE_CHARMS, UPGRADE_ORDER, OpenStackRelease
27: 
28: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
29: 
30: 
31: @dataclass
32: class Analysis:
33:     """Analyze result.
34: 
35:     :param apps_control_plane: Control plane applications in the model
36:     :type apps_control_plane:  Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
37:     :param apps_data_plane: Data plane applications in the model
38:     :type apps_data_plane:  Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
39:     """
40: 
41:     model_name: Optional[str]
42:     apps_control_plane: Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
43:     apps_data_plane: Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
44: 
45:     @classmethod
46:     async def create(cls, model_name: Optional[str] = None) -> Analysis:
47:         """Analyze the deployment before planning.
48: 
49:         :param model_name: Name of model to query, if None the current model will be used
50:         :type model_name: Optional[str]
51:         :return: Analysis object populated with the model applications.
52:         :rtype: Analysis
53:         """
54:         logger.info("Analyzing the OpenStack deployment...")
55:         apps = await Analysis._populate(model_name)
56: 
57:         control_plane, data_plane = await cls._split_control_plane_and_data_plane(apps)
58: 
59:         return Analysis(
60:             model_name=model_name, apps_data_plane=data_plane, apps_control_plane=control_plane
61:         )
62: 
63:     @classmethod
64:     async def _split_control_plane_and_data_plane(
65:         cls, apps: Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
66:     ) -> tuple[list[OpenStackApplication], list[OpenStackApplication]]:
67:         """Split control plane and data plane apps.
68: 
69:         :param apps: List of applications to split.
70:         :type apps:  Iterable[OpenStackApplication]
71:         :return: Control plane and data plane application lists.
72:         :rtype: tuple[list[OpenStackApplication], list[OpenStackApplication]]
73:         """
74:         data_plane = []
75:         control_plane = []
76:         for app in apps:
77:             if app.charm in DATA_PLANE_CHARMS:
78:                 data_plane.append(app)
79:             else:
80:                 control_plane.append(app)
81:         return control_plane, data_plane
82: 
83:     @classmethod
84:     async def _populate(cls, model_name: Optional[str]) -> list[OpenStackApplication]:
85:         """Analyze the applications in the model.
86: 
87:         Applications that must be upgraded in a specific order will be returned first, followed
88:         by applications that can be upgraded in any order. Applications that are not supported
89:         will be ignored.
90: 
91:         :param model_name: Name of model to query
92:         :type model_name: Optional[str]
93:         :return: Application objects with their respective information.
94:         :rtype: List[OpenStackApplication]
95:         """
96:         juju_status = await juju_utils.get_status(model_name)
97:         apps = {
98:             AppFactory.create(
99:                 name=app,
100:                 status=app_status,
101:                 config=await juju_utils.get_application_config(app, model_name),
102:                 model_name=model_name,
103:                 charm=await juju_utils.extract_charm_name(app, model_name),
104:             )
105:             for app, app_status in juju_status.applications.items()
106:         }
107:         # remove non-supported charms that return None on AppFactory.create
108:         apps.discard(None)
109:         # mypy complains that apps can have None, but we already removed.
110:         apps_to_upgrade_in_order = {
111:             app for app in apps if app.charm in UPGRADE_ORDER  # type: ignore
112:         }
113:         other_o7k_apps = apps - apps_to_upgrade_in_order
114:         sorted_apps_to_upgrade_in_order = sorted(
115:             apps_to_upgrade_in_order,
116:             key=lambda app: UPGRADE_ORDER.index(app.charm),  # type: ignore
117:         )
118:         # order by charm name to have a predicable upgrade sequence of others o7k charms.
119:         other_o7k_apps_sorted_by_name = sorted(
120:             other_o7k_apps, key=lambda app: app.charm  # type: ignore
121:         )
122:         return sorted_apps_to_upgrade_in_order + other_o7k_apps_sorted_by_name  # type: ignore
123: 
124:     def __str__(self) -> str:
125:         """Dump as string.
126: 
127:         :return: String representation of Application objects.
128:         :rtype: str
129:         """
130:         return (
131:             "Control Plane:\n"
132:             + "\n".join([str(app) for app in self.apps_control_plane])
133:             + "Data Plane:\n"
134:             + "\n".join([str(app) for app in self.apps_data_plane])
135:         )
136: 
137:     @property
138:     def current_cloud_os_release(self) -> Optional[OpenStackRelease]:
139:         """Shows the current OpenStack release codename.
140: 
141:         This property just consider OpenStack charms as those that have
142:         openstack-origin or source on the charm configuration (app.os_origin).
143:         :return: OpenStack release codename
144:         :rtype: OpenStackRelease
145:         """
146:         control_plane = (app for app in self.apps_control_plane)
147:         all_apps = chain(control_plane, self.apps_data_plane)
148:         return min(
149:             (app.current_os_release for app in all_apps),
150:             default=None,
151:         )

15: """Upgrade planning utilities."""
16: 
17: import logging
18: from typing import Callable
19: 
20: from cou.apps.app import OpenStackApplication
21: from cou.apps.subordinate import OpenStackSubordinateApplication
22: from cou.exceptions import HaltUpgradePlanGeneration, NoTargetError
23: from cou.steps import UpgradeStep
24: from cou.steps.analyze import Analysis
25: from cou.steps.backup import backup
26: 
27: logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
28: 
29: 
30: async def generate_plan(analysis_result: Analysis) -> UpgradeStep:
31:     """Generate plan for upgrade.
32: 
33:     :param analysis_result: Analysis result.
34:     :type analysis_result: Analysis
35:     :return: Plan with all upgrade steps necessary based on the Analysis.
36:     :rtype: UpgradeStep
37:     """
38:     target = getattr(analysis_result.current_cloud_os_release, "next_release", None)
39:     if not target:
40:         raise NoTargetError("Cannot find target to upgrade.")
41: 
42:     plan = UpgradeStep(description="Top level plan", parallel=False, function=None)
43:     plan.add_step(
44:         UpgradeStep(description="backup mysql databases", parallel=False, function=backup)
45:     )
46: 
47:     principal_upgrade_plan = await create_upgrade_group(
48:         analysis_result=analysis_result,
49:         description="Principal(s) upgrade plan",
50:         target=target,
51:         filter_function=lambda app: not isinstance(app, OpenStackSubordinateApplication),
52:     )
53:     plan.add_step(principal_upgrade_plan)
54: 
55:     subordinate_upgrade_plan = await create_upgrade_group(
56:         analysis_result=analysis_result,
57:         description="Subordinate(s) upgrade plan",
58:         target=target,
59:         filter_function=lambda app: isinstance(app, OpenStackSubordinateApplication),
60:     )
61:     plan.add_step(subordinate_upgrade_plan)
62: 
63:     return plan
64: 
65: 
66: async def create_upgrade_group(
67:     analysis_result: Analysis,
68:     target: str,
69:     description: str,
70:     filter_function: Callable[[OpenStackApplication], bool],
71: ) -> UpgradeStep:
72:     """Create upgrade group.
73: 
74:     :param analysis_result: Result of the analysis.
75:     :type analysis_result: Analysis
76:     :param target: Target OpenStack version.
77:     :type target: str
78:     :param description: Description of the upgrade step.
79:     :type description: str
80:     :param filter_function: Function to filter applications.
81:     :type filter_function: Callable[[OpenStackApplication], bool]
82:     :return: Upgrade group.
83:     :rtype: UpgradeStep
84:     """
85:     group_upgrade_plan = UpgradeStep(description=description, parallel=False, function=None)
86:     for app in filter(filter_function, analysis_result.apps_control_plane):
87:         try:
88:             app_upgrade_plan = app.generate_upgrade_plan(target)
89:         except HaltUpgradePlanGeneration as exc:
90:             # we do not care if applications halt the upgrade plan generation
91:             # for some known reason.
92:             logger.debug("'%s' halted the upgrade planning generation: %s", app.name, exc)
93:             app_upgrade_plan = None
94:         except Exception as exc:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
95:             logger.error("Cannot generate upgrade plan for '%s': %s", app.name, exc)
96:             raise
97:         if app_upgrade_plan:
98:             group_upgrade_plan.add_step(app_upgrade_plan)
99: 
100:     return group_upgrade_plan
